tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lhag pa'i lha bzhir dus gtor 'bul ba'i phrin las bzhugs so// spyan drang ba ni/ e/ drag po chos dbyings gshin rje'i zhing khams nas// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// 'jam dpal khros pa khro chu dug gdong dang*// kiṃ kang dmar nag shor sang nyi ma khros// 'char ka nag po 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+shar bcas// dam tshig thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs// oṃ ya mān+ta ka ya ma rā dza badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ e| gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na// pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed po'i tshogs// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ e/ 'jam dpal khros pa khro rgyal tshogs rnams la// bdag cag mos pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal zhing*// dad pa rab kyis mi btang sgrub bgyid na// lha rnams ci bder dgyes pa'i las mdzod cig /ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra na maskā ra yā mi/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ e/ ya mān+ta ka 'khor dang bcas pa la// phyi mchod mchod yon me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri// ro dang reg chos rgyal srid bdun dang ni// bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad sogs mchod par 'bul// nang gi mchod pa khrag chen ar+ghaṃ dang*// dbang lnga'i me tog sha chen bdug spos dang*| |tshil chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab dang*// sha rus zhal zas rkang gling thod rnga'i sgra// dur khrod nang gi mchod pa 'bul gyi bzhes// gsang chen bde chen khro mo sbyor ba'i yum// dga' bskyed gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos lnga// snyoms 'jug 'dzag med dga' bde'i mchod pa ni// 'bul gyi tshim zhing dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /de bzhin nyid mchod 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// spros bral gzung 'dzin mi dmigs mnyam pa nyid| |bdag gzhan gnyis snang ngo bo stong pa ste// mchod bya mchod byed bral bas dgyes gyur cig

/oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad| rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu/ sap+ta ma hā rat+na/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la/ ma hā sh+ma shā na ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ a nu rā ga ya ma hā su kha/ ma hā mu dra pū dza pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhan+dha ru// lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta// sbyangs spel sbar ba kha raṃ khā hi// lcang lor bcas pa'i dung chen por// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i ru dhī ra// mkha' dbyings pad+ma rak+ta dang*// 'ben chen gsang ba'i khrag dang sbyar// dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ dgyes par rol| |bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du// rgyu rkyen phun sum tshogs sbyar ba'i// ba liṃ rgyan ldan rab 'bar ba// 'bul lo bzhes rol tshim par mdzod// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ma hā ba ling+ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dbul/ slar lha rang rang gi sngags mthar/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta= ma hā rak+ta= ma hā ba ling+ta= ma hā maṃ sa/ rak+ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ go ro tsa na/ srog ādz+nyā la kā ma gu ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sbyar ba nyer gcig sogs kyis dbul/ thugs dam bskang ba ni/ e/ bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang*// phyi mchod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// gsang ba'i mchod pas= /de bzhin mchod pas= /bdud rtsi sman gyis= /'ben chen rak+tas= /ba liṃ gtor mas= /'dod yon kun gyis= /dam rdzas 'bar bas= /spyan gzigs yod dgus= /longs spyod 'byor pas= /khro chu dug gdong = /kiṃ kang dmar nag= /'char ka nag po'i thugs= /nā ga rak+sha'i= /thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// bshags pa ni/ hoḥ bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis| |bag med spyod pas dam las 'gal gyur te// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs gyur pa// 'jam dpal khro rgyal tshogs kyi thugs dang ni// 'gal bar gyur pa gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags// tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub dus 'dir stsol// ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya nyer gcig sogs bzla/

bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ e/ rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur dus gsum du// mngon sangs rgyas kyang rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul// gang 'dul der snang chu zla ltar snang ba// 'phags mchog 'gro ba'i bla mar bdag phyag 'tshal// rigs gsum kun 'dus las kyi gshin rje'i gshed// mthu stobs dpag med phyi nang dgra bgegs 'dul// sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba// khro chu dug gdong sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'chi bdag bdud 'joms shor sang nyi ma khros// kiṃ kang dmar nag mthu rtsal stobs dang ldan// drag po dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad lhag pa'i lha// kiṃ kang khro rgyal khyod la bdag bstod do// pha rol rgol ngan kun 'joms dregs pa'i gtso// las kun thogs med sgrub pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba// 'char ka nag po'i sku la bdag bstod do// klu dang sa bdag ma lus dregs pa'i tshogs// tshar gcod rjes 'dzin klu yi srin po che// phrin las thogs med mdzad pa rig pa'i rgyal// nā ga rak+sha'i sku la bdag bstod do// dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i tshogs// bzhes la sngags 'chang sgrub po bdag nyid kyi// 'dod don zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// gang bcol ma thogs myur du 'grub pa dang*// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu dngos grub deng stsol cig /ces bstod/ lha rang rang gi bsnyen pa ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni/ e ya/ 'jam dpal las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs// rigs gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs dang*// shor sang khros pa'i lha tshogs dang*// 'char ka nag po'i lha tshogs dang*// rig pa'i rgyal po'i lha tshogs rnams// sngags 'chang gdung bas 'bod pa'i tshe// myur du byon la sman rak+ta// gtor mchod tshogs la dgyes par rol// bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi// sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la// rtag par dgyes bzhin bzhugs nas kyang*// bdag 'dod bcol ba'i phrin las ni// nad gdon mi mthun bar chad kun// zhi bar mdzod cig shān+tiṃ ku ru// tshe bsod dpal 'byor la sogs kun// rgyas par mdzod cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru// mos bzhis khams gsum srid pa gsum// dbang du bsdus shig wa sh+yaṃ ku ru// dgra bgegs gnod byed dmigs bya rnams// drag pos sgrol cig mā ra ya// gzhan yang gang bcol las kyi gnyer// myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'dod pa'i sman raka gtor mar bcas// sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag 'bul// phyi bcol las kyi zhu skyems 'bul| |da 'chol las kyi gnyer zas 'bul// bzhes shig rol cig dgyes tshim mdzod// las bcol bden pas mi bsgrub na// sngon gyi dam bcas yal bar 'dor// de bas bcol ba'i phrin las rnams// da lta nyid du 'grub par mdzod// myur ba nyid du 'grub par mdzod// ces gtor ma 'bul/

lhag pa'i lha bzhir// dgu gsum sogs kyi/ dus kyi gtor ma// 'bul tshig 'khyer bder// bkod pa'i phrin las// chos kyi grags pa'i// nyer mkho nyid yin// don kun 'dus tshe/ /tshig la mang nyung*/ /khyad par med do/ /dge bas 'gro kun/ /'jam dpal sa thob/ /de la bdag smon/ /myur du 'grub par// gyur cig e waṃ// //
